description: Imports workouts exported from OTHER systems (Garmin or Strava export, GPX from an Apple Watch app or any tracker) into a local store, ~/.suunto-mcp/imported/ (SUUNTO_IMPORT_DIR moves it), apart from the Suunto archive. `path` is an ABSOLUTE path to one .fit, .gpx or .tcx file or a folder (only files directly in it; no subfolders, links, hidden files, .gz or .zip: unpack first). macOS-protected folders (~/Downloads, ~/Desktop, ~/Documents) cannot be read: have the user copy the files to e.g. /tmp/workouts. Files are stored byte for byte plus a <id>.json record (SHA-256, summary; files 0600); nothing is ever overwritten or deleted. The same file again is skipped; a DIFFERENT file starting within 60 s of a stored one and lasting within 5 % of it is NOT imported but listed in possibleDuplicate. A file that is not what its extension says, is truncated, over 50 MB or fails the checks (valid timestamps not in the future, positions on the globe, GPS jumps over 12 m/s dropped (30 for cycling or unknown sport), 2+ GPS points for GPX) is listed in refused and nothing is written. A call examines at most 200 files and imports at most `limit` new ones: CALL AGAIN with `after` = nextAfter until remaining is 0. Lists show their first 50 entries (*Count fields hold totals). No Suunto call, no network. estimate_route_time also uses imported walking, hiking or running workouts (sport from a FIT session, a GPX's first track <type> (untyped files, likely including Apple Watch GPX, do not count; unverified) or a TCX Sport attribute (TCX walks and hikes do not count)). Only a FIT file's first session is read. Sleep, HRV and recovery are NOT imported; Apple Health's export.xml is not supported. Parsers verified on synthetic files only.

after.description: Only files sorting after this name are looked at: pass the previous call's nextAfter.

limit.description: Most new workouts this call (1-50, default 50).

path.description: Absolute path to one .fit, .gpx or .tcx file, or a folder (not recursive).

source.description: Label kept in each record: garmin, strava, apple or other (default).

name: import_workouts
title: Import workouts from other systems (Garmin, Strava, GPX/TCX/FIT files) to local files
